programmes.t: On the Case: Blood Money
programmes.d: After 21 years, DNA analysis of a blood-stained dollar bill helps to solve the murder of gas station clerk Bradley Perry.

programmes.t: On the Case: Web of Torment
programmes.d: The abduction of a young mother from a crowded hospital parking lot is the beginning of a terrifying mystery that will torment her loved ones for decades.

programmes.t: On the Case: Justice Never Quits
programmes.d: Mary-Jane Marquardt, mother and wife from Chippewa, Wisconsin, was found stabbed to death in her own home. With Mary-Jane's son also missing, the detectives couldn't help but wonder if his disappearance was connected to the murder.

programmes.t: On the Case: Gone in a Blink
programmes.d: A teenager waiting for her friends to give her a ride home from work suddenly disappears. When her friends arrive, they find terrifying evidence of her abduction.

programmes.t: On the Case: When, Where, and Who?
programmes.d: A 15-year-old girl vanishes from her front porch, and police have only a few short hours to determine who saw her last, where she was going, and who would want her dead.

programmes.t: On the Case: Field of Nightmares
programmes.d: A young mother and son are found shot to death in a quiet Texas field. Would a mysterious bag left at the crime scene hold the key to catching their killer?

programmes.t: On the Case: Murder Ordained?
programmes.d: When a young minister's wife is found dead, it appears to be a tragic accident. But then, another member of the congregation is murdered. Police begin to wonder if its just a coincidence or a calculated plot.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Ray of Darkness
programmes.d: Police must connect two vicious murders in order to bring a single killer to justice.

programmes.t: On the Case: Pattern of Violence
programmes.d: A 22 year old real estate agent is discovered strangled to death inside a model home she was trying to sell.

programmes.t: On the Case: Cry on My Shoulder
programmes.d: When a young woman disappears, police zero in on her violent ex-boyfriend. But the secret to solving the case is buried in a cold case file.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Window to Murder
programmes.d: A valiant teenager's dying act helps police solve the mystery behind her murder

programmes.t: On the Case: Hidden by Fire
programmes.d: When firefighters respond to a raging house fire they discover the blaze was just the cover up for a vicious murder.

programmes.t: On the Case: Christina's Story
programmes.d: When a young girl vanishes while walking her dog on a military base, it marks the beginning of a missing persons case that would capture the hearts of the entire county.

programmes.t: On the Case: Murder at Bird Key
programmes.d: A successful business man is found brutally murdered in his palatial Southern Florida home. A mysterious backpack found at the crime scene is the key to the case.

programmes.t: On the Case: Courage and Conviction
programmes.d: A college student's battle for survival may be the key to solving a double homicide from years earlier.

programmes.t: On the Case: Message In Blood
programmes.d: When police arrive at the scene of a grisly murder they wonder if the victim's dying act would point them to her killer.

programmes.d: March 17, 1986 in Deerfield Beach, Florida 5- year-old Stacy Savage happily bounded up the street to the spot where her mother Angela Savage and her little brother met her after school. But when Stacy got there, her mother was nowhere to be found

programmes.t: On the Case: A Harvest of Grief
programmes.d: Paula Zahn examines the tragic case of a trail of blood and broken cornstalks leads police to the body of a young girl.

programmes.t: On the Case: The Killer Rang Twice
programmes.d: Linda Donahew, of Arlington Texas, was discovered stabbed to death by her sister one night in June. For nearly two decades the case remained unsolved, until detectives matched DNA from Linda's case with another case a few hundred miles away.

programmes.t: On the Case: Salt in the Wound
programmes.d: An independent young woman starting out in life on her own, becomes the victim of a bizarre and vicious homicide in her apartment.

programmes.t: On the Case: Taken
programmes.d: In the span of 8 months, 3 young girls are kidnapped from their homes and murdered. When their killer strikes again a young girl's heroic actions solves the case.

programmes.t: On the Case: Trapped by Lies
programmes.d: Before police can catch a depraved killer of a 15 year old girl, they must first unravel a puzzling series of lies.

programmes.t: On the Case: Clearing the Docket
programmes.d: A teenager vanishes during a walk to the store on a cold winter night. The next morning, police find her lifeless body in a snowbank six miles away.

programmes.t: On the Case: Snapshot to Murder
programmes.d: A high school student vanishes into thin air during a day studying in the park. Will a photograph from a nearby celebration help solve the case?

programmes.t: On the Case: Deadly Offer
programmes.d: After coming to the aid of a stranded roommate, Stephanie Brown's car is found abandoned on the interstate and her body is later discovered floating in an irrigation ditch, the victim of sexual assault and murder.

programmes.t: On the Case: One of Us
programmes.d: A young records clerk at the Seattle police department is murdered on her way to work her overnight shift. Can police find the evidence to catch the killer of one of their own?

programmes.t: On the Case: Heartbreak in the Heartland
programmes.d: A quiet Midwestern community is rocked by a gruesome triple homicide. The unspeakable tragedy robs one man of his mother, grandmother and 5 year old son.
